stories.title: Franklin Templeton (BEN) Reports 2% Decline in September AUM Amid Market Headwinds
stories.summary: Franklin Templeton (BEN) reported a 2% decline in September AUM to $1.79 trillion due to market volatility, though year-over-year AUM increased by 7.8%.
